info.title: Rush CMS public API
info.description:
Read API for sites built on Rush CMS, plus form submission. Every operation under `/api/v1/{site_id}` requires a
bearer API token bound to that site; `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` is public.

**Tokens and perspectives.** A delivery token reads the published perspective. A preview token (an API token of
scope `preview`, or a signed `rush_prv_` preview link valid for one hour) reads the draft perspective by default and
may ask for `perspective=published`. Draft responses carry `X-Rush-Perspective: draft` and
`Cache-Control: no-store`, are never cached and carry no `ETag`. Only entries, tag entries, entry terms, authors,
the homepage, navigation entry targets and tag counts depend on the perspective; every other resource is live.

**Locales.** Locale codes are returned as stored (`pt_BR`); only `Content-Language` uses BCP 47 (`pt-BR`). The
requested locale L comes from `?locale=`, then `Accept-Language` (quality order, base-language match), then the
site default. Structure (collection, tag and navigation names and slugs, site option group names, form
labels) always falls back through the site's preference order for L. Content (entries, homepage, site option field
values, navigation targets) follows the site flag `fallback` (`serve_untranslated_fallback`): when on, each item is
served in the first locale of the preference order it exists in and is marked `fallback: true` when that locale is
not L; when off, only content translated into L exists. Blocks, link pages and database names and slugs are locale-less.

**Caching.** Successful GETs in the published perspective carry a strong `ETag` (hash of the body) and
`Cache-Control: no-cache`; `If-None-Match` answers `304` with no body. The server cache key uses the resolved
locale. `Vary: Accept-Language` is sent only when the locale did not come from `?locale=`.

**HTTP.** Every GET also answers `HEAD` (same status and headers, no body). CORS applies only to origins allowed by
the site (its domain and allowed domains): preflight allows `GET, HEAD, OPTIONS` and the headers `Authorization`,
`Content-Type`, `Accept`, `If-None-Match`; `ETag` and `X-Rush-Perspective` are exposed. Form submission is meant
to come from the site's server, never from a browser. A documented query parameter or header sent more than once
(`?page=1&page=2`, two `If-None-Match` lines) answers `400` `bad_request`.

**Errors.** Every error is JSON `{"error", "code", "params"?, "errors"?}` (see `Error`). `error` is English text
for logs; `code` is the stable value clients branch on and localize. Unknown paths under `/api/v1` answer `404`
`not_found` (`params.resource: route`) and a known path with an unsupported method answers `405`
`method_not_allowed`. A request running longer than the global timeout answers a bare `504` with an empty body;
that response is outside this contract.

**Rich text.** Rich-text field values inside `data` and `values` are TipTap JSON documents (see `RichText`).

origin.description: Scheme, host and port of the instance.

tags.name: Entries

tags.name: Tags

get.description:
Serves the embedded contract as JSON. Needs no token, may be cached and is readable from any origin
(`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`). A matching `If-None-Match` answers `304`.
Locales, default locale, timezone and the fallback flag of the site. Perspective-independent.

Content rule: with the site flag on, the homepage of the first locale of the preference order that has one
(`fallback: true` when it is not L); with the flag off, only L's homepage, otherwise `404 not_translated`.
Sends `Content-Language` with the served locale in BCP 47.
Unpaginated. Ordered by creation time, oldest first. Names and slugs follow the structure rule.

Paginated; `per_page` defaults to the collection's `items_per_page`. Content rule: each entry appears once,
in its served translation. Order: when the collection `is_reorderable`, `sort_order` ascending with nulls
last, then `published_at` descending, then entry id descending; otherwise `published_at` descending, then
entry id descending. The trailing id keeps pages stable. A page past the end answers an empty `data` with
the real `meta.total`.

Paginated like `listEntries`. Each entry is matched against its served translation (content rule) with that
translation's text search configuration; title weighs more than excerpt, excerpt more than data. Order:
relevance descending, then `published_at` descending, then entry id descending. A missing or blank `q`
answers an empty page.

Exactly one URL answers 200 per (entry, requested locale L); every other URL reaching the entry gets a coded
404 the site turns into a redirect.

1. The served translation T of an entry E: flag off, E's translation in L if it exists; flag on, E's first
   translation in the preference order.
2. A current slug in L equal to `{entry}` finds E (T is then L's translation).
3. Else a current slug in another active locale finds E (several matches: the locale first in the preference
   order, then the smallest entry id).
4. Else a retired slug (slug history) in any locale finds E; the most recent retirement wins. Current slugs
   always win over history.
5. For E found in 3 or 4: T exists and `T.slug == {entry}` → 200; T exists with another slug → `404 moved`
   with `params {locale, slug, collection_id, collection_slug}`; no T → `404 not_translated` with `params.available`.
6. Nothing found → `404 not_found` (`params.resource: entry`).
7. `{collection}` resolves through the collection slug of any locale, but a 200 also requires it to equal the
   collection slug in L; otherwise the answer is `moved`, carrying both corrections at once.

Sends `Content-Language` with T's locale in BCP 47.

Unpaginated. Ordered by name, then tag id. Names and slugs follow the structure rule. `entry_count` is the
number of entries `listTagEntries` lists for the same locale and perspective (`entry_count == meta.total`).
A `type` other than `tag` or `category` answers `400 bad_request`.

get.summary: Entries carrying a tag or category
get.description:
Paginated; `per_page` defaults to 15. Entries of every active collection, content rule as in `listEntries`
(each carries its own `collection`). Order: `published_at` descending, then entry id descending.

Tag and category slugs are unique per type, so one slug can name both a tag and a category. Pass `type` to
resolve the slug within that taxonomy only; a slug absent from it answers `404 not_found`. Without `type`
the slug resolves across both taxonomies: the translation earliest in the locale preference order wins, and
on a tie a tag wins over a category. Always pass `type` when a slug may exist in both taxonomies.
A `type` other than `tag` or `category` answers `400 bad_request`.
Unpaginated. Ordered by key. Items keep their stored order.

Unpaginated. Non-private groups ordered by their sort order, then slug; private fields are never listed.
Values are live (no draft model). Name and description follow the structure rule; field values follow the
content rule (an untranslated localized field is `null`).
A private or unknown group answers `404 not_found`.
Unpaginated, without items. Ordered by creation time, oldest first. Names and slugs follow the structure rule.

`{database}` matches the database slug. Items form a flat list
ordered by `order`, then creation time; rebuild the tree with `parent_item_id`.

get.summary: One active link page by slug

get.description: Unpaginated. Ordered by key. Labels follow the structure rule.

get.summary: One active form schema by key

post.summary: Submit a form from the site's server
post.description:
Sent by the site's server on behalf of a visitor. `X-Rush-Client-IP` carries the visitor IP used for limits
and stored with the submission; without a valid single IP literal the connection IP is used. Limits: 5 per
minute per site, form and visitor IP, and 60 per minute per site; every attempt counts. When the site enables
captcha (Cloudflare Turnstile) every form requires a token, read from the body field `cf-turnstile-response`
or the `X-Captcha-Token` header, and verified with the visitor IP. A filled honeypot field
(`Form.honeypot_field`) is discarded silently and answers exactly like a real submission. Unknown keys are
ignored. Body limit 1 MiB. Preview tokens and the draft perspective cannot submit.

bearerAuth.description:
An API token of the site (`rush_live_…` in production, `rush_test_…` elsewhere; scope `delivery` or
`preview`) or a signed preview link token (`rush_prv_…`, one hour, draft perspective). Keep every token on
the server; none is safe in a browser.

SiteId.name: site_id
SiteId.description: The site id (ULID), never its slug. Must be the site the token belongs to.

CollectionSlug.name: collection
CollectionSlug.description: Collection slug in any locale of the site.

EntrySlug.name: entry
EntrySlug.description: Entry slug, current or retired, in any locale (see the resolution steps).

TagSlug.name: tag
TagSlug.description: Tag or category slug in any locale of the preference order.

FormKey.name: key
FormKey.description: Form key (lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 255 characters).

Locale.name: locale
Locale.description:
Requested locale. Matching ignores case and `-`/`_` and accepts a base language (`pt` → `pt_BR`). When absent,
`Accept-Language` decides, then the site default. A value the site does not serve answers
`400 locale_not_served`.

Perspective.name: perspective
Perspective.description:
`published` (default for delivery tokens) or `draft` (default for preview tokens; a delivery token gets
`403 preview_requires_preview_token`). Any other value answers `400 invalid_perspective`.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Page number, from 1. Below 1 means 1; a non-numeric value answers `400 bad_request`.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description:
Page size. Below 1 means the operation's default; above 100 is clamped to 100; a non-numeric value answers
`400 bad_request`.

Query.name: q
Query.description: Search text in PostgreSQL web-search syntax (quoted phrases, `or`, `-term`).

TagType.name: type
TagType.description: Which taxonomy to list; `tag` when omitted. Any other value answers `400 bad_request`.

EntriesTagType.name: type
EntriesTagType.description: Restricts the slug to one taxonomy. Without it the slug resolves across both. Any other value answers `400 bad_request`.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: An `ETag` from an earlier response; a match answers `304`.

ClientIp.name: X-Rush-Client-IP
ClientIp.description: The visitor IP as seen by the site's server; a single IPv4 or IPv6 literal, otherwise ignored.

CaptchaToken.name: X-Captcha-Token
CaptchaToken.description: Turnstile token, when not sent as the body field `cf-turnstile-response`.

ETag.description: Strong validator (hash of the body). Present on 200 and 304 in the published perspective only.

CacheControl.description: `no-cache` in the published perspective (revalidate with `If-None-Match`); `no-store` in the draft perspective.

Vary.description:
`Accept-Language` when the operation resolves a locale and `?locale=` was absent; `Origin` when CORS
applied.

RushPerspective.description: Present, with value `draft`, only in the draft perspective.

Cache.description: Server cache state; `BYPASS` in the draft perspective or when the cache is unavailable.

ContentLanguage.description: Locale of the served translation, in BCP 47.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until a new attempt may succeed.

HomepageOk.description: The homepage in its served locale.

EntryOk.description: The entry in its served translation.

TagListOk.description: Tags or categories with their entry counts.

FormSubmitted.description: Received. A real submission and a discarded honeypot submission answer identically.

BadRequestParameter.description: `bad_request`: a query parameter or header is sent more than once.

example.error: If-None-Match is sent more than once

BadRequest.description: `invalid_perspective`: `perspective` is neither `published` nor `draft`. `bad_request`: a query parameter or header is sent more than once.

BadRequestLocale.description:
`locale_not_served` (`params.available` lists the site's locales): `?locale=` names a locale the site does not
serve. `invalid_perspective`: `perspective` is neither `published` nor `draft`. `bad_request`: a query parameter or header is sent more than once.

example.error: locale "fr" is not served by this site

BadRequestQuery.description:
`bad_request`: `page` or `per_page` is not a number, `type` is neither `tag` nor `category`, or a query
parameter or header is sent more than once.
`locale_not_served` (`params.available` lists the site's locales): `?locale=` names a locale the site does
not serve. `invalid_perspective`: `perspective` is neither `published` nor `draft`.
Precedence: `invalid_perspective` is decided with the token, before the other parameters; every
`bad_request` then comes before `locale_not_served`.

BadRequestSubmit.description:
`bad_request`: the body cannot be parsed as JSON, multipart or urlencoded, the form key does not match its
pattern, or a query parameter or header is sent more than once. `invalid_perspective`: `perspective` is neither
`published` nor `draft`.

Unauthorized.description:
`unauthorized`: missing, unknown or revoked token, inactive site, or a preview link whose issuer lost the view
permission or whose links were revoked. `token_expired`: the API token or the preview link expired.

Forbidden.description:
`forbidden`: the token belongs to another site. `site_suspended`: the site's billing is suspended.
`preview_requires_preview_token`: `perspective=draft` with a delivery token.

ForbiddenSubmit.description:
`forbidden`, `site_suspended` and `preview_requires_preview_token` as on reads, plus `preview_cannot_submit`:
a preview token or the draft perspective cannot submit.

NotFound.description:
`not_found`, with `params.resource` naming what is missing: `collection`, `tag`, `navigation`,
`site_option_group`, `block`, `database`, `link_page` or `form`.

NotFoundTranslatable.description:
`not_found` (`params.resource: homepage`): no homepage in any served locale. `not_translated`
(`params.available` lists the locales that have one): the flag is off and L has none.

UnprocessableSubmit.description:
`validation_failed` with `errors` (one `FieldError` per failed rule). `captcha_failed`: captcha is enabled and
the token is missing or rejected.

example.error: too many requests, please retry later

CaptchaUnavailable.description: `captcha_unavailable`: the captcha verifier could not be reached; retry later.

LocaleCode.description: A locale code as stored by the site (`en`, `pt_BR`).

domain.description: The site's primary domain, if set.

locales.description: Active locales, in the site's configured order.

fallback.description: Whether untranslated content is served from the preference order (`serve_untranslated_fallback`).

slug.description: Collection slug in the requested locale (structure rule).

TagRef.description: A tag or category attached to an entry; name and slug follow the structure rule.

entry_count.description: Entries `listTagEntries` lists for the same locale and perspective.

Media.description:
A media file referenced by content. Every key is optional: `url` is absent when the stored URL is unsafe, and
the descriptor fields are absent when the file is not a media item of this site.

MediaVariants.description:
Derived files keyed by variant name; `thumb` is a 300px WebP. A stored JSON null is served as an empty
object.

MediaMap.description: Media referenced by the content, keyed by media id.

status.description: Always `published` in the published perspective; the working state in the draft perspective.

sort_order.description: Manual position in reorderable collections; absent when unset.

fallback.description: True when the served locale differs from the requested locale.

translations.description:
Every translation of the entry that exists in the request perspective, in the site's active locales,
including the served one, keyed by locale code.

FieldValues.description:
Field values keyed by field name; each value takes the form its field type gives it (see `FieldValue`). In
entries, shared fields are merged with the served translation's localized fields. Only fields the current
blueprint declares are returned, at every depth (top level, repeater items, block values, rich-text custom
blocks); values under keys it no longer declares are omitted. A collection without a declared field layout
returns its top-level values as stored. Unsafe URLs are blanked; text is returned verbatim. Admin presentation
settings of the fields (such as widths) are never part of the values.

FieldValue.description:
The value of a top-level field of an entry or a site option group: a `NonBlockFieldValue`, or a `BlockValue`
for block fields.

NonBlockFieldValue.description:
The value of a top-level field of any type except block: a `LeafFieldValue`, or a `RepeaterValue` for
repeater fields. Blocks cannot contain block fields, so every value of a block's own fields takes this form.

LeafFieldValue.description:
A value that may appear at every depth. Text, textarea, select, color and markdown fields hold a string; image
and file fields a media URL (joined with `media`); checkbox, list, gallery and category fields a
`StringListValue`; rich-text fields a `RichText` document; database fields a `DatabaseFieldValue`. `null` when
unfilled, and for a block field whose block no longer exists.

StringListValue.description: Selected options, list rows, gallery media URLs or category ids.

BlockValue.description: The value of a block field; `values` follow the block's fields.

BlockValues.description:
The values of a block's fields keyed by field name, with the same rules as `FieldValues`. Blocks cannot
contain block fields, so each value is a `NonBlockFieldValue`.

DatabaseFieldValue.description:
The selected items of a database field, at any depth, resolved in the requested locale and in stored order;
unknown or deleted items are left out. Always an array, also for single-choice fields (at most one item).

name.description: Name in the requested locale (preference order).

description.description: Description in the requested locale; empty when unset.

parent_id.description: ULID of the parent item; null for a root item.

RepeaterItemId.description: Stable item id assigned by the server on every write; use it as the item key.

RepeaterValue.description: The items of a top-level repeater field, in stored order.

RepeaterItem.description:
One item of a top-level repeater: `_id` plus the repeater's declared sub-fields. A sub-field holds a
`RepeaterItemValue`, exactly as a top-level field of its type.

RepeaterItemValue.description:
The value of a sub-field of a top-level repeater item: any `LeafFieldValue` or a `NestedRepeaterValue` (a
repeater inside a repeater). Block fields are not allowed inside repeaters.

NestedRepeaterValue.description: The items of a repeater nested in a repeater item (the deepest level allowed), in stored order.

NestedRepeaterItem.description: One item of a nested repeater; its sub-fields hold `LeafFieldValue`s (no further repeaters).

EntrySummary.description: The served translation of an entry, enough to build its URL.

fallback.description: True when the served locale differs from the requested locale.

translations.description:
Locales that have a homepage in the request perspective, among the site's active locales, in the site's
configured order, including the served one.

HomepageSection.description:
A block instance. `values` follow the block's fields like `EntryData`: only declared fields at every depth,
database values expanded in the requested locale, unsafe URLs blanked. Values of a block that no longer
exists are returned as stored, with unsafe URLs blanked.

id.description: Section id chosen by the editor.

block.description: Block slug; null when the block no longer exists.

HomepageMeta.description: SEO of the served locale; null when never set.

items_per_page.description: Default `per_page` of the collection's entry lists.

NavigationItem.description:
An entry or collection item whose target cannot be served (unpublished, untranslated under the content rule,
inactive collection) is dropped, unless it has surviving children; it then stays without `target`.

link_target.description: The HTML `target` of the link (for example `_blank`).

NavigationTarget.description: Exactly one key, matching the item `type`.

url.description: Empty when the stored URL is unsafe.

NavigationAttribute.description: An extra HTML attribute; names are allow-listed (`data-*`, `aria-*`, `title`, `rel`, `id`, `role`, `lang`, `hreflang`, `download`, `type`).

values.description: One key per public field; `null` when unfilled or untranslated under the content rule.

Block.description:
`fields` is the block blueprint as stored (field groups, or `{main, sidebar}`) without admin presentation
settings: field widths (`data.config.width`) are left out at every depth. `locations` says where the block may
be used, as stored, and is absent when unset.

LinkPageLink.description: A link as stored by the admin; URLs are sanitized.

LinkPageTheme.description: Theme as stored by the admin; URLs are sanitized. A stored JSON null is served as an empty object.

honeypot_field.description: Name of the hidden input that must stay empty.

FormCaptcha.description: Present when the site requires a captcha on its forms.

handle.description: Body key of the field on submit.

FormSubmission.description:
Field values keyed by `FormField.handle`; a `checkbox` takes several values (a JSON array, or the key
repeated). JSON scalars are read as strings. May carry `cf-turnstile-response` and the honeypot field.

error.description: English message for logs; never shown to visitors.

ErrorParams.description: Parameters of the error, by code.

available.description: `locale_not_served`: the site's locales. `not_translated`: the locales the resource exists in.

slug.description: `moved`: the entry slug to redirect to.

collection_id.description: `moved`: the id of the collection the entry belongs to.

collection_slug.description: `moved`: the collection slug to redirect to.

FieldErrorCode.description:
`required`: empty required field. `invalid_option`: value outside the options (`params.value`).
`invalid_email`, `invalid_url`, `invalid_number`: wrong format for the field type. `too_small` / `too_large`:
number below `params.min` / above `params.max`. `too_short` / `too_long`: fewer than `params.min` / more than
`params.max` characters. `invalid_format`: value does not match the field `pattern`.

RichText.description:
A TipTap JSON document. Nodes follow TipTap StarterKit plus `codeBlock` (`attrs.language`), `image`
(`attrs.src`, `attrs.alt`, `attrs.align`, `attrs.mediaId`, join with `media` by `mediaId`), `gallery`
(`attrs.images`, `attrs.layout`, `attrs.lightbox`), the `link` mark (`attrs.href`, empty when unsafe) and
`customBlock` (see `CustomBlockNode`).

RichTextContent.description: A rich-text node; `customBlock` nodes take the `CustomBlockNode` shape.

type.description: Any TipTap node type except `customBlock`, which takes the `CustomBlockNode` shape.

CustomBlockNode.description: An inline use of a block inside rich text.
